description: The DSL words record (cy_dsl_words_v1), after each state of each stream, from the same Robot and Tracker as tracker.json. It is the interpreter context of src/dsl/common.js read from protocol 2, with robot-core.md section 2.5 applied: the cue is the Tracker's (smallest bearingError, kept 60 ticks), cue-error is its bearingError, cue sources are protocol 2's and bearing-rate uses match.tickRate. Absent values are your heading for bearings, 0 for elevations and 1000000000000 for distances. Strings and booleans compare exactly.
rule: |actual - expected| <= tolerance * max(1, |expected|), field by field; a case's tolerance is the file's unless tolerances names its call
